title: First look at She's Fine, Elizabeth Banks's new comedy for Apple TV
summary: The series, which also stars Ted Danson, begins on 27 January.
body:
Apple TV has released the first pictures from She's Fine, a new comedy series starring Elizabeth Banks.

Banks plays Heidi, a recently divorced mother trying to make a fresh start for herself and her children, while also getting drawn into her father's busy love life at his retirement community.

Cast and dates

The cast also includes Ted Danson, Rob Delaney and Katey Sagal. The series was created by Liz Heldens and Matt Ward, and Banks is also an executive producer.

The first two episodes arrive on Wednesday 27 January 2027, with new episodes each week until 24 March.

Sources: Apple TV, UPI, 9to5Mac.
